about.title: Winter
about.intro: The trio formed almost by accident during a December night at Blue Note Tokyo. Misaki was playing a solo set, Kenta joined her, and Reina borrowed the drums. They played until 4am under the year's first snowfall.
about.quote: "Like the falling snow, the changing moon, and the flowers that bloom then fade, our jazz is alive, impermanent."
